Tell the user, and let them choose: /textguard reviews and approves this exact content, /textguard on delivers flagged web results as untrusted data instead of withholding them, and /textguard off stops scanning for the session. Do not silently retry the same request.

proposals.notes: Complete modelWithheldText composition with named English constants expanded; cause is the existing optional colon-prefixed evidence clause. HUMAN-only projection proposal, not permission to translate the fixed-English model policy. Use structured evidence and existing textguard detail/unavailable IDs to localize a human cause. Do not translate scanned bytes, hashes, approval identity or old saved results; full cause/count branches are not drafted here.

proposals.notes: Complete banner with constants expanded, not actual source payload. HUMAN-only structured projection must replace the evidence expression with existing catalog detail/unavailable IDs; keeping this expression is a placeholder-preservation notation, not a claim the model formatter emits Japanese. ADVISORY_PREFIX is recognized by isAdvisory and must remain English in model/stored content to avoid double scanning/banners. Existing source text, protocol hashes and model instructions remain intact.
